gloss: to be liked; to be popular

definitions.gloss: to be liked; to be loved; to be popular
definitions.explanation: The passive form of {好|す}く, used to express that someone or something is liked or well-received by others. Much more common than the active form {好|す}く in modern Japanese.

examples.japanese: みんなに{好|す}かれている。
{先生|せんせい}に{好|す}かれる{生徒|せいと}になりたい。
examples.english: I want to be the kind of student that teachers like.

examples.japanese: {人|ひと}に{好|す}かれるためには、まず{相手|あいて}の{話|はなし}をよく{聞|き}くことが{大切|たいせつ}だ。
examples.english: To be liked by others, it is important to first listen carefully to what they have to say.

notes:
The passive form of {好|す}く (to like), but far more commonly used than the active form in modern Japanese. While {好|す}き (the adjective) is the standard way to express liking something, {好|す}かれる is the natural way to say someone is liked by others. The active verb {好|す}く is relatively rare in speech.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- みんなに{好|す}かれる: to be liked by everyone
- {人|ひと}に{好|す}かれる: to be liked by people
- {好|す}かれる{性格|せいかく}: a likable personality
- {好|す}かれる{人|ひと}: a popular/well-liked person

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {愛|あい}される: to be loved — deeper emotional attachment than being liked
- モテる: to be popular (romantically) — specifically about romantic attractiveness
- {人気|にんき}がある: to be popular — broader, can apply to things, places, celebrities

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {好|す}かれていませんでした
